title: Dotterel
summary: DOTTEREL, noun The name of different species of fowls, of the genus Charadrius and the grallic order; as the Alexandrine dotterel the ringed dotterel and the Morinellus; also, the turnstone or sea dot

inlines.v: DOTTEREL, noun The name of different species of fowls, of the genus Charadrius and the grallic order; as the Alexandrine dotterel the ringed dotterel and the Morinellus; also, the turnstone or sea dotterel a species of the genus Tringa.
